subject: Urgent: SOC 2 evidence sprint + bridge letter to close HealBridge deal
messages:
From: Peter Bloodsworth <peter.bloodsworth@healbridge.com>
To: Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwood.ai>
Cc: Emma Li <emma.li@healbridge.com>
Date: Tue, 17 Nov 2026 09:18:00 -0800
Subject: SOC 2 Type II + bridge note request (audit period clarification)

Hi Dylan,

Thanks again for the demo last week — HealBridge is excited about Redwood’s latency profile. Our procurement/security team ran the checklist and we have two time-sensitive asks before our legal can issue an LOI:

1) Copy of your SOC 2 Type II report (we need the report and the auditor cover sheet).
2) A bridge letter if the report audit period does not include our go-live window (we need assurance on controls between the report end date and go-live). Also confirm your SOC 2 audit period dates clearly.

We’re on a tight schedule — can you provide these by Friday 11/20? If not, can you propose a short-term attestation or interim mitigation?

Appreciate the quick turnaround — cc’ing Emma (infosec lead) for any specific evidence she may request.

Best,
Peter
Peter Bloodsworth
Head of Security Operations, HealBridge
From: Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwood.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 17 Nov 2026 09:42:00 -0800
Subject: Fwd: SOC 2 Type II + bridge note request (audit period clarification)

Marissa / Vivek — forwarding HealBridge's asks. This deal is at an LOI moment; they want SOC2 + bridge letter by this Friday 11/20.

Marissa: HealBridge is a mid-size telehealth provider, potential first enterprise customer in our Telehealth vertical — closing this quarter is important for ARR and the sales org.

Vivek / Monica: can security produce either the full report + auditor cover or a bridge letter/interim attestation that covers the gap if our report ends before their go-live? If we can’t produce the final signed report, what is the fastest defensible artifact we can provide to unblock LOI?

Quick asks:
- Confirm exact SOC 2 audit period we can claim in the bridge letter
- Minimal evidence list we can share this week (logs, control owner attestations, KMS config screenshots)
- Owner + ETA for delivery

I can own client communication once you give artifacts.

Thanks,
Dylan
Dylan Brooks
Enterprise Sales, Redwood Inference
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwood.ai>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 17 Nov 2026 10:11:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Fwd: SOC 2 Type II + bridge note request (audit period clarification)

Dylan — thanks for flagging. HealBridge is on our board for Q4 closers; if we stall on SOC2 we risk them pausing the LOI.

Customer context from previous calls: they need assurance for patient-data handling during a Nov–Dec pilot (PHI adjacency). They are comfortable with a short bridge that states our controls state as of the audit period end + explicit interim compensating controls.

I recommend:
- Security produces a bridge letter draft by EOD Thursday (11/19).
- Provide a 1-page evidence matrix this week with the minimal items we can safely share.

Vivek — can you confirm you have capacity to produce the draft and whether legal needs to review?

If we can hit Friday, I’ll push legal/procurement for an LOI with a 30-day condition.

-Marissa
Marissa Cole
Senior Account Executive, Redwood Inference
From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwood.ai>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 18 Nov 2026 14:05:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Fwd: SOC 2 Type II + bridge note request (audit period clarification)

Thanks for the heads-up. Quick status: our most recent Type II report covers the period 2025-10-01 to 2026-09-30 (audited by Kestrel LLP). We do not yet have a Type II spanning past 9/30/2026.

We can provide the full report (redactions applied for customer-data-sensitive sections) and a formal bridge letter that:
- Restates the audited period (10/01/2025 - 09/30/2026)
- Affirms there were no control exceptions identified during the audited period
- Describes compensating controls and monitoring in place from 10/01/2026 to present (log retention, per-route latency monitoring, change control sign-offs)
- Provides point contacts for any further evidence requests

What I need from ops teams by EOD Thursday:
- Screenshots / export of KMS key policy and rotation schedule (ops)
- Evidence of change-control tickets for the last 90 days (SRE)
- Token-level access logs for a sample 30-day window (privacy/compliance)

Monica — can you draft the bridge letter and attach an evidence matrix template? I’ll review and add security wording. Legal will want to sign off but we can iterate fast.

-Vivek
Vivek Kulkarni
Director, Security & Compliance, Redwood Inference
From: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 19 Nov 2026 17:34:00 -0800
Subject: Drafts: bridge letter + evidence matrix (for HealBridge)

Vivek / team — attaching draft artifacts for review. I’m including:
- bridge_letter_redwood_draft.docx (contains audit period statement + interim compensating controls)
- evidence_matrix_healbridge_request.xlsx (minimal shareable artifacts flagged)
- SOC2_TypeII_report_redwood_2025-10-01_to_2026-09-30.pdf (redacted, auditor cover page included)

Notes:
- Redactions: customer-identifying sample data removed; auditor cover page preserved.
- Bridge letter language is intentionally conservative: it avoids forward-looking commitments, states controls in place since audit end, and offers an attestation by Director, Security.
- Legal review requested but not blocking for an LOI; advise preferred if you want signature.

ETA: I can finalize after Vivek’s security wording and a quick legal review. Please mark edits in the docx.

—Monica
Monica Patel
Security Operations Manager, Redwood Inference
(attachment stubs: bridge_letter_redwood_draft.docx, evidence_matrix_healbridge_request.xlsx, SOC2_TypeII_report_redwood_2025-10-01_to_2026-09-30.pdf)
From: Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwood.ai>
To: Peter Bloodsworth <peter.bloodsworth@healbridge.com>
Cc: Emma Li <emma.li@healbridge.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 20 Nov 2026 16:02:00 -0800
Subject: Re: SOC 2 Type II + bridge note request (audit period clarification)

Peter / Emma — thanks for the clear ask and the timeline. We appreciate how time-sensitive this is for your LOI. Attached are the artifacts Monica assembled (redacted report, evidence matrix, and a draft bridge letter).

Summary and next steps:
- SOC 2 Type II audited period: 2025-10-01 to 2026-09-30 (auditor: Kestrel LLP). Attached: auditor cover page + redacted report.
- Draft bridge letter attached; it affirms no exceptions during the audit period and describes interim compensating controls in place from 2026-10-01 to present. Vivek will sign the final attestation once legal confirms wording.
- Requested evidence (KMS policy screenshot, change-control exports, sample logs) are listed in the evidence_matrix_healbridge_request.xlsx. We can deliver the minimal exports within 48 hours upon your confirmation of what you need to see.

Please confirm if the draft bridge letter is acceptable as a short-term attestation to proceed with an LOI. If you need additional items, tell us which rows in the evidence matrix you want prioritized and we’ll expedite.

Thanks — looking forward to getting this across the line.

Best,
Dylan Brooks
Enterprise Sales, Redwood Inference
(attachments: bridge_letter_redwood_draft.docx; evidence_matrix_healbridge_request.xlsx; SOC2_TypeII_report_redwood_2025-10-01_to_2026-09-30.pdf)
